sections.text_helper: Section 16.3 "EXTI functional description" in chapter 16 (Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 448.
sections.section_content:
The events features are controlled from register bits as follows:
• Active trigger edge enable
– by rising edge selection in EXTI_RTSRx
– by falling edge selection in EXTI_FTSRx
• Software trigger in EXTI_SWIERx
• Interrupt pending flag in:
- EXTI_RPRx
- EXTI_FPRx
• CPU wake-up and interrupt enable in EXTI_IMR1 and EXTI_IMR2
• CPU wake-up and event enable in EXTI_EMRx
